P000.desc: 辺境の小村で育った心優しい青年。幼い頃に魔物から村を救われた経験から、強くなることを誓う。
P000.name: シレン

P001.desc: 名門貴族の若き当主。気品と責任感を併せ持ち、腐敗した貴族社会を改革しようと志す。冷静だが情熱的な一面も。
P001.name: アシュレイ

P002.desc: 王国軍の名門槍騎兵隊の家系に生まれたが、家を離れ傭兵や用心棒をしている。
P002.name: キジー

P003.desc: 魔力の濃い森で生まれた天才魔術師。幼い頃から魔力が暴走しがちで、感情が力に直結する繊細な体質。
P003.name: ミレイユ

P004.desc: スラム街で育ち、幼い頃から身軽さと機転で生き延びてきた義賊。
P004.name: カイ

P005.desc: 深い森に住む長命のエルフ族の娘。自然と精霊の声を聞く力を持ち、森の守護者として育てられた。
P005.name: リーファ

P006.desc: 旅をしながら物語を紡ぐ吟遊詩人。港町の酒場で育ち、世界中の歌や伝承を学んできた。
P006.name: ルード

P007.desc: 砂漠のオアシス都市で生まれた踊り子。幼い頃から舞と歌で旅人を魅了してきた。
P007.name: フィオナ

P008.desc: 荒野の闘技場で育った孤児。自分を拾ってくれた師匠の教えを胸に、真の強さを求めて旅を続ける。
P008.name: ランガ

P009.desc: 霧深い山里に隠れ住む忍びの一族の生まれ。任務のためならどんな危険にも身を投じるが、仲間を守るためには掟すら破ることもある。
P009.name: シグレ

P010.desc: 王国を守る近衛騎士団の家系に生まれたエリート。厳格な性格だが、弱き者には誰よりも優しい。
P010.name: クラリス

P011.desc: 行商人の家に生まれ、幼い頃から各地を旅してきた経験豊富な商人。利益だけでなく人との縁を大切にし、どんな相手とも誠実に取引する。
P011.name: ロッシュ

P012.desc: 北方の森に住む小さな種族・コロボックルの青年。自然と共に生きる民で、植物や動物と心を通わせる力を持つ。
P012.name: ポックル

P100.desc: Hiruma scout of the Kaiu Wall. Gallows humour; holds the line.
P100.name: Hiruma Natsuko

P101.desc: Kakita duelist, yojimbo to the Keeper of the House Honour.
P101.name: Kakita Rensei

P102.desc: Kitsuki junior yoriki. Evidence over testimony.
P102.name: Kitsuki Gendo

P103.desc: Akodo strategist from a minor house. Thinks in go.
P103.name: Akodo Shizue

P104.desc: Isawa shugenja of Water and Void. Counts on his fingers.
P104.name: Isawa Haruki

P105.desc: Shosuro agent. Nobody is very easy to be.
P105.name: Shosuro Mitsue

P106.desc: Ide emissary. Being liked is his only weapon; he keeps it sharp.
P106.name: Ide Tamotsu

P107.desc: Wave-woman herbalist born on a rice barge.
P107.name: Sayo

P120.desc: Hida Sachiko. A loud Wall veteran with a big hammer.
P120.name: Hida Sachiko

P121.desc: Hiruma Ryoichi. Natsuko's friend; peasant weapons.
P121.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

P122.desc: Squeak-of-Many-Eggs. Talk good-good. Steals maps for a good cause.
P122.name: Squeak

P123.desc: Kage's bodyguard at court. A bent katana and big fists.
P123.name: Hiruma Goro

P124.desc: Phoenix Inquisitor, Earth tensai. Brilliant, and he knows it.
P124.name: Isawa Michio

P125.desc: Gonta of the Hidden Ones. Big, patient, and fond of landslides.
P125.name: Gonta

P126.desc: The Hiruma daimyo, without armour. A fallen tetsubo.
P126.name: Hiruma Kage

P127.desc: Hiruto's younger son. Matsu-trained, war-hungry, grinning.
P127.name: Akodo Gusai

P128.desc: One of Lord Hiruto's riders. Does what Gusai says, mostly.
P128.name: Lion rider

P129.desc: Toturi's advisor. A short sword, and nothing left to lose.
P129.name: Akodo Kafu

P130.desc: Shizue's uncle. Calm as a go board, and as hard to read.
P130.name: Akodo Hiruto

P131.desc: Kamasari's yojimbo. Lean, controlled; his grandfather screams in his ear.
P131.name: Shiba Ashimita

P134.desc: An Imperial guard of the year 400. He was at the end of his rope. Gendo cut a different sentence.
P134.name: Seppun Ushimo

P135.desc: A bright boy of twelve with ink on his fingers. He thinks the fire has a spirit. He's right.
P135.name: Isawa Sanro

P136.desc: A junior Mantis yoriki running a magistracy alone. Loud when she's frightened, so: loud.
P136.name: Yoritomo Rui

P137.desc: An Emerald Magistrate, Phoenix, very small, very precise. Her whole team is dead or worse.
P137.name: Isawa Kasiko

P138.desc: The tribunal's escort. Raised as the son her father wanted; fights as herself now, mostly.
P138.name: Akodo Rin

P140.desc: Tsune's niece, assigned to keep the emissary alive. Says very little. Stands in front of things.
P140.name: Shinjo Ryuko

P141.desc: A Matsu, granddaughter of a legend. Proud, sharp, and about to find out what her family's glory is made of.
P141.name: Matsu Hanae

P139.desc: A young Tamori monk in heat-wards. Says what he smells. Usually right.
P139.name: Tamori Haku

P133.desc: A tired Crane yoriki. Eats rice balls on steps; listens when nobody else will.
P133.name: Doji Hayato

P132.desc: A tattooed Togashi. Keeps a tally of the Fortunes' attempts on his life. He is winning.
P132.name: Togashi Yosai
